title: Agoda’s COO on AI Booking: ‘Nobody Knows’ the Business Model Yet
summary: Agoda wants to win AI agents' business the way it wins travelers': on price, speed and reliability. What it can't say yet is what those agents will eventually cost it, and that answer will matter more to its margins than any integration.

title: Dubai Gets Some Airlines Back as Riyadh Waits on Houthis
